name: awesome-chinese-open-models
description: A curated, auto-updated index of Chinese open-source AI models with benchmarks, hardware matching, deploy commands, and licenses. Built by OpenModelMap.

paragraphs: A curated, auto-updated index of Chinese open-source AI models — benchmarks, hardware requirements, deploy methods, licenses — all in one place. Built and maintained by OpenModelMap.
Last updated: 2026-10-11 00:20 UTC Total models: 187 Categories: 4

This is the open-source index behind OpenModelMap (openmodelmap.com), an AI model decision engine for the Chinese open-source AI ecosystem. It helps developers answer: "Which open-source model should I use — and can I run it on my hardware?"
features: 2,800 open-source models tracked — parameters, licenses, tasks, downloads in one place
Benchmark & hardware matching — each model links to verified data (benchmarks, GPU requirements, deploy commands)
Auto-updated daily from HuggingFace, ModelScope and more — quality-gated to filter out variants and garbage
Live & maintained — the website runs in production; this list regenerates automatically
